verdict.rationale: Brex documents first-party AI assistants that fetch receipts and offer policy help, and a review agent that follows up with anyone out of compliance, which covers the receipt-chasing and policy-guidance parts of the story. There is no evidence of the assistant explaining card declines, and pre-spend "can I expense this?" answers are only implied by the vague phrase "policy help." missing for 10: documented decline explanations, explicit pre-spend conversational policy Q&A, detailed docs on the conversational interface, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, an AI assistant enforces policy conversationally — chasing missing receipts, explaining declines, and answering "can I expense this?" before the spend happens

citations.quote: AI assistants do employees' expenses for them, writing memos, fetching receipts, offering policy help, even filing reimbursements automatically.
